fusions.name: Word of Halting
fusions.desc: Speaks a halting word into the cone ahead of you, which deals 11 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Syllable
fusions.desc: Sends a single spoken syllable that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Recited Ward
fusions.desc: Recites a ward over your shell that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Learned by Rote
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
